dedupe_keys.name: gisual power outage intelligence api commercial near real time utility outage status

description: Gisual sells an API that tells network operations centres whether a site has lost commercial power, by aggregating near real-time outage information from electricity utilities, so that telecom operators and managed service providers can triage down devices without calling utilities or checking outage maps. The company says it is used by Fortune 500 telecom companies and cites network operations centres such as AT&T and RCN; outputs include outage attribution and estimated times of restoration from local utilities, and it integrates with ticketing and monitoring tools such as ServiceNow, SolarWinds, IBM Netcool, Remedy and ScienceLogic. Coverage is utility service areas it serves, mainly in the United States. Format and access: a commercial REST API with sign-up and demo. Licence: proprietary, paid. Caveats: the method and coverage figures are marketing claims not documented publicly, and data depend on what utilities publish. It is a source of power-to-telecom dependency signals for emergency response and cascading failure analysis. A related catalogue record is PowerOutage.com's outage data products.
